reviews.text: Charlie always does such a beautiful job with both of our dogs, who are not always the easiest to groom! After just a few visits they're now much calmer, which is credit to Charlie's patience and expertise :)

I cannot believe how amazing Charlie is a true Dog whisperer and my Fiadh goes to no one even the vets have not been able to succeed looking at her nails , yet out she came all trimmed , super happy and most definitely be back
Was Benji's first time at the groomers and he was nervous when he arrive but he left a happy dog with a fresh trim. Charlie did a great job! we will be going back.
My dog was very happy and looked great 😊 …
Amazing job on my Shih Tzus, very communicative, amazing price and dogs look and smell amazing post groom - will definitely be returning! Thank you so much for all the care with my babies ❤️
Is very nice job, me and my doggie very happy, and we definitely coming back xx

Charlie groomed my 7 month old Mishka and I am more than happy with the results he looks so handsome. I already can’t wait for his next appointment I can’t recommend Charlie enough. He also gave me advice of brush / comb to use on my boys coat as I wasn’t sure. Thank you so much ❤️
Charlie is a fantastic groomer. I couldn't be happier with how well my two German Shepherds are taken care of, and at such a reasonable price!
I got both my cats done here just for a flea bath and tidy up, he was very professional stayed calm even though my cat was screaming would 100% recommend

The best dog groomer around! My dog has been groomed by Charlie at his previous place and I’ve always been very happy with how my dog looks. Charlie’s service is amazing, he’s very attentive and responsive to any questions. My dog can be quite fussy when it comes to grooming but Charlie handles him very well.
